method: Ordinal triage: 50% current official activity signal, 30% likely harm and breadth, 20% recency and cross-sector corroboration. Not a precise national prevalence ranking because official datasets use different scopes and definitions.

items.name: Business email compromise and invoice or mandate fraud
HMRC, tax, refund and benefit impersonation scams
Postal, courier-collection and doorstep payment fraud

limitations: UK official datasets are not directly comparable; ranks are ordinal triage, not precise national prevalence.
Latest ONS prevalence estimates cited are for England and Wales; Scotland reporting routes differ.

Cifas/GASA exposure and loss figures are a UK survey with a stated 16 March–13 April 2026 field period and updated methodology; they are not directly comparable with ONS incidents, Cifas database cases or NCSC report/removal counts.

Direct Report Fraud and UK Finance pages were not used as quantitative evidence where automated retrieval was unavailable; official reporting routes were validated through Stop! Think Fraud and the linked service guidance.
